reading.title: A different morning
paragraphs: Mina usually walks to work. She often drinks tea before work. Today she is taking the bus because it is raining. On the bus, she is reading a short story.
Mina enjoys the quiet walk because she can look at the trees. At work, she usually starts at nine and speaks with her colleagues.
After the bus journey, she meets her colleague Ali. He is waiting near the office. They go inside together and make a cup of tea.

reading.title: A plan for Saturday
paragraphs: Leyla likes walking. She walks in the park twice a week. Her friend Omar is calm and kind. This Saturday, Omar would like to visit a café after their walk. Leyla would like some tea.
Omar likes walking too, but he prefers quiet streets. He works near the park, so he often visits it after work. Leyla works from home and enjoys meeting a friend outside.
They usually talk about books and music. At the café, they choose a table near the window and plan their next walk.

reading.title: A family afternoon
paragraphs: Deniz usually visits her aunt twice a month. Her aunt’s son, Can, is Deniz’s cousin. Can is calm and friendly, and he likes gardening. His daughter Ece enjoys looking at the flowers in the garden.
Today Deniz is taking the bus to her aunt’s house. She is bringing a book for Ece. Her uncle is making tea, and her aunt is preparing a small cake. Can and Ece are working in the garden.

After tea, the family would like to look at old photographs. Deniz’s aunt tells a funny story about her childhood, and everyone laughs. Deniz enjoys these afternoons because the family spends time together.

reading.title: A different Friday
paragraphs: Nora usually walks home after work. On Fridays, she often visits her cousin Sami. They meet twice a month, and they like talking about books and music. Sami is friendly and calm, and his sister Lina is very kind.
Today is different. It is raining, so Nora is taking the bus to Sami’s house. She is carrying a new book for him. At home, Sami is making dinner, and Lina is preparing a salad.
After dinner, Nora would like a cup of tea. Sami usually drinks coffee, but tonight he would like tea too. They sit by the window and make a plan to walk in the park on Sunday if the weather is good.
